concepts.gloss_en: "The fear of the LORD is his treasure" (Isaiah 33:6) — fear as a stored-up treasure
"A woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised" (Proverbs 31:30) — fear as that which is praised; associated with the nose/smell

notes: Two distinct scriptural verses sharing only the opening words 'יראת ה' היא'; different sources (Isaiah 33:6 vs Proverbs 31:30) and different homiletic uses (treasure/otzar vs praise/nose). Token-overlap is superficial — not the same concept.
